## Overview

Auli, located in Uttarakhand’s Chamoli district, is India’s premier skiing destination, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Himalayas, including Nanda Devi. Situated at 2,500m to 3,050m, this “meadow” features long slopes ideal for skiing (January–March) and the Asia’s second-longest cable car, making it a popular year-round hill station.

### Highlights

-  Thrilling snow adventures
- Asia's longest cable car rides
- Gorson Bugyal Trek
- Auli Artificial Lake
- Camping and Bonfires

 Day 02 :
  Visit To Auli | Skiing and Gorson Bugyal Trek

After breakfast at hotel head towards Joshimath (45 minutes drive) then reach Auli by cable car or by road.
Reach Auli and experience the amazing panoramic view of the Himalayan Ranges.
Enjoy Skiing & other snow activities or trek to Gorson Bugyal.
After a tiring but equally beautiful day get back to hotel.

 Day 03 :
  Departure

Wake up lazy and after breakfast checkout from hotel.
Say goodbye to the Mountains and Depart for Delhi.
Reach back to Delhi by early morning next day with amazing trip memories.
